name: copilotkit
summary: I followed the CopilotKit quickstart exactly: created a Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, scaffolded the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` endpoint with `BuiltInAgent`, wrapped the layout in `<CopilotKit>`, and added `<CopilotSidebar>` to the page. TypeScript checked clean (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). However, the dev server started but never finished compiling — it hung indefinitely at `○ Compiling / ...` and all HTTP requests returned empty responses. No `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment, so I had to use a dummy placeholder. The production build was also killed (exit 137, likely OOM). Consequently, I never reached a demonstrably working copilot endpoint.
